environment: managed cloud; not the Windows production host
database_scope: Reduced validation stack: real PostgreSQL + pgvector, PostgREST, internal TLS gateway, HTTP Caddy; no Storage service. Windows compose retains pinned Supabase images.

load.fixtures: distinct synthetic accounts and standard bearer sessions; not OAuth

cloud_runner_note: Tool containers are reused via docker exec to avoid large VFS copies. Workload, image, mounts and CPU/memory limits match the compose profiles.
notes: Only the 100-user comparisons passed. 300/500/1000 higher-load cases are diagnostics, not an accepted capacity level.
Both initial and tuned-budget profiles are retained; higher load was run on this isolated bounded cloud stack, not production.
The 32 GiB cloud filesystem uses VFS; final runs had approximately 0.8 GiB free. They are not representative of the Windows SSD or its Docker storage driver.
